description: Create a new VPC Peering connection between two VPCs. Use dryRun=true to preview without creating.

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating the resource

targetVpcLoginId.description: Target VPC owner login ID (required for cross-account peering)

targetVpcName.description: Target VPC name (required for cross-account peering)

vpcPeeringName.description: VPC Peering name (3-30 chars; lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens; must start and end with an alphanumeric character)

name: ncloud_create_vpc_peering
